name: P1032: a pipe gets colour, the isatty term dropped (test_text_report.TheStyleTest.test_a_pipe_is_plain_whatever_term_says)
find: motion = is_terminal(stream) and environ.get("TERM", "") not in DUMB_TERMS

name: P1032: dumb counts as a usable TERM (test_text_report.TheStyleTest.test_dumb_unknown_and_unset_term_are_plain_on_a_terminal)
P1032: an empty NO_COLOR removes colour (test_text_report.TheStyleTest.test_no_color_set_and_not_empty_removes_colour_and_keeps_motion)
P1032: FORCE_COLOR wins over NO_COLOR (test_text_report.TheStyleTest.test_force_color_adds_colour_never_motion_and_no_color_wins)
find: colour = (motion or bool(environ.get("FORCE_COLOR"))) and not environ.get("NO_COLOR")
replace: colour = bool(environ.get("FORCE_COLOR")) or (motion and not environ.get("NO_COLOR"))

name: P1032: FORCE_COLOR adds motion (test_text_report.TheStyleTest.test_force_color_adds_colour_never_motion_and_no_color_wins)
replace: return TextStyle(colour, motion or bool(environ.get("FORCE_COLOR")), can_encode_marks(stream))

name: P1032: an empty section prints its heading (test_text_report.TheLayoutTest.test_the_layout_holds_the_status_line_the_facts_each_section_and_the_step)
find: return [[("  " + heading, "heading")]] + items if items else []

name: P1032: a finding's fix is dropped (test_text_report.TheLayoutTest.test_the_layout_holds_the_status_line_the_facts_each_section_and_the_step)
find: items += [[("      fix: " + printable(found.fix), "quiet")]] if found.fix else []

P1032: with no step, no No command line (test_text_report.TheLayoutTest.test_the_layout_holds_the_status_line_the_facts_each_section_and_the_step)
find: return [[("  Next:", "heading")], [("    " + NO_COMMAND_MESSAGE % first, "fact")]] if first else []

name: P1032: the Note comes after Next (test_text_report.TheLayoutTest.test_the_layout_holds_the_status_line_the_facts_each_section_and_the_step)
find:
blocks = [TextReport.findings_block(result.findings),
                  TextReport.section("Note", [[("    " + printable(note), "quiet")] for note in notes]), TextReport.next_block(result)]
replace:
blocks = [TextReport.findings_block(result.findings),
                  TextReport.next_block(result), TextReport.section("Note", [[("    " + printable(note), "quiet")] for note in notes])]
